title: God Reveals the King's Dream to Daniel
summary_text: Nebuchadnezzar orders Babylon's wise men killed because they cannot tell him both his dream and its meaning. Daniel asks his friends to seek God's mercy, and God reveals the mystery to him in a vision. Giving God the credit, Daniel describes a statue made of different metals and clay, shattered by a stone that becomes a mountain. He explains that the statue represents successive kingdoms, beginning with Nebuchadnezzar's, but God will establish a kingdom that lasts forever. The king honors Daniel's God, promotes Daniel, and appoints his friends to positions of responsibility.

title: God Rescues Three Men from the Furnace
summary_text: Nebuchadnezzar commands everyone to worship his golden statue or die in a blazing furnace. Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refuse, saying that God can rescue them but that they will not worship the statue even if He does not. The furious king has them thrown into an overheated furnace, then sees four unharmed men walking inside. The three come out completely untouched by the fire. Nebuchadnezzar praises their God for sending His angel, threatens anyone who speaks against Him, and promotes the three men.
